image_description: A close-up portrait of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a species of guenon, perched on a tree branch. The monkey has dark grey/black fur on its back and limbs, a white chest ruff, and a distinctive bare face with a bluish-grey tint and a narrow nose. It features a cap of darker fur on its head. The background is a soft-focus green forest.
